beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Paris exposes the technical production of legitimacy through calendar inclusion, monumental rooms, official images, digital programmes, showrooms and archives. This chapter follows backstage coordination: The same field that helps a show run—a name, measurement, image, availability or location—can also make labor newly trackable and extractable.
beats.onScreen: Then: FHCM says it has operated SPHERE since January 2020 to support selected emerging brands.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: FHCM says it has operated SPHERE since January 2020 to support selected emerging brands. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: For the 2026 womenswear session, FHCM identifies Palais de Tokyo, an invitation-only digital version and The New Black as its technology provider.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The public showroom page does not reveal private buyer accounts, prices, order volumes, sell-through or participating brands’ downstream systems.
